name: Logify – Comprehensive WordPress Event Logger, Activity Monitor, and Audit Log for Tracking User Actions and Site Events
author: KaizenCoders

sections.description:
Logify – A WordPress User Activity Log plugins is a powerful WordPress plugin that monitors and records user activity with detailed audit logs. Gain clear insights into events happening on your site, track changes effortlessly, and ensure accountability. Perfect for improving security, compliance, and transparency, it helps you manage and monitor all WordPress activities with ease.

From user logins and role changes to post updates, plugin activations, WooCommerce order changes, and SEO tweaks — Logify records it all in one clean dashboard.

This makes it easier for site owners, agencies, and teams to improve security, troubleshoot faster, and meet compliance requirements (GDPR, HIPAA, ISO, etc.).

Why Use a Logify (User Activity Log) in WordPress?

Keeping track of everything that happens on your WordPress site is essential for security, compliance, and smooth site management. Logify makes it simple with a detailed, easy-to-use activity log.

🔒 Security & Compliance
Detect failed logins, suspicious user role changes, and unusual activity in real-time. Stay compliant with GDPR, HIPAA, and other industry regulations by maintaining a reliable audit trail.

🔧 Troubleshooting & Debugging
When something breaks, Logify shows you exactly what changed and when. Track plugin and theme updates, content edits, and configuration changes to resolve issues faster.

👥 User Accountability & Audit Trails
Know who did what, when, and from where. Perfect for teams, agencies, and organizations that need transparency and legal compliance.

⚡ Performance & Site Health
Monitor plugin installations, theme modifications, and system events that could impact your site’s performance, speed, or stability.

💾 Smarter Backup Strategy
Pair backups with activity logs for complete protection. Identify exactly what needs restoring and when changes were made.

🛡️ WordPress Security Monitoring
Stay ahead of threats by tracking failed login attempts, suspicious activities, and potential security risks before they become bigger problems.

🔑 Key Features

  • Track everything – user logins, role changes, content edits, plugin & theme changes, system events, and more.
  • Detailed activity logs – see who did what, when, and from where.
  • Advanced filtering – search by user, role, event type, or date range.
  • Built-in integrations – works with WooCommerce, Yoast SEO, membership plugins, and popular form builders.
  • Export logs – download logs as CSV or JSON for reporting or audits.
  • Custom retention settings – control how long logs are stored.
  • Privacy friendly – IP anonymization & data masking options.
  • Lightweight & optimized – built with performance in mind.
  • Admin-only access – restrict log viewing to administrators for security.
  • Easy setup – works out of the box with zero configuration.
  • Complete uninstall – removes all plugin data on uninstall for a clean database.
  • Developer friendly – hooks and filters for custom integrations.
  • Regular updates & support – we’re here to help and keep improving.

📊 Perfect For

  • Business & Corporate Websites: Ensure GDPR compliance, meet audit trail requirements, and maintain accountability for internal or external reviews.
  • WooCommerce & Online Stores: Track orders, product edits, inventory changes, customer details, and coupon usage to prevent fraud and improve compliance.
  • Multi-Author & Multi-User Sites: Monitor who logs in, edits content, or changes roles so you always know what’s happening on your site.
  • Staging & Development Environments: Keep a clear history of theme changes, plugin activations, and site updates during testing or client projects.
  • Agencies & Freelancers: Deliver transparent reports to clients, prove maintenance work, and document every change for accountability.
  • Membership Communities: Log member signups, subscription updates, content access, and moderation actions for better community management.
  • Schools, LMS & Training Portals: Track student activity, course changes, and instructor updates to maintain a reliable digital learning environment.
  • News & Publishing Platforms: Follow editorial workflows, publication timelines, author contributions, and SEO adjustments with complete clarity.

Complete Uninstall & Database Hygiene

Clean & Professional Removal

Our plugin offers a thorough uninstall process that removes all plugin-related data when uninstalled. The cleanup routine automatically deletes the custom activity log table, plugin settings, scheduled tasks, and related metadata, ensuring your WordPress database is restored to its original, clutter-free state.

️ Database Integrity Assurance

We care about the long-term health of your database. The uninstall process includes validation steps to guarantee full data removal without impacting any other WordPress functionality. This ensures you can test or temporarily use Activity Log Pro with confidence, knowing no residual data will remain.

️ Security & Privacy

Activity Log Pro is built with your privacy and security at its core:

  • IP Address Anonymization by Default – IPs are automatically masked (e.g., 192.168.1.xxx) to protect user privacy
  • WordPress Security Standards – Implements best practices like prepared statements and input sanitization for database safety
  • Customizable Data Retention – Configure log retention periods to align with your privacy policies
  • Administrator-Only Access – All features are restricted to administrators for maximum security

WP CLI Commands

Logify includes WP CLI commands for advanced users to manage logs directly from the command line:

  • wp logify clear – Clear all activity logs from the database
  • wp logify clear --user-id={USER-ID} – Clear logs for a specific user by user ID.
  • wp logify clear --user-id={USER-ID} --event-type={EVENT-TYPE} – Clear logs for a specific user and event type.

🔧 Easy Setup & Configuration

Logify is designed to work instantly with zero configuration. Just install and activate, and it starts recording important activities right away.

Quick start in minutes:
1. Install and activate the plugin – it works out of the box with smart defaults
2. (Optional) Choose which activities you want to track
3. (Optional) Set log retention rules to control storage
4. Start monitoring your WordPress site immediately

No technical skills required – Logify is beginner-friendly but also includes advanced options for power users who want fine-grained control.

💡 Popular Use Cases
– Troubleshooting: Quickly identify what changed right before your site broke.
– Compliance: Generate audit trails to meet GDPR, HIPAA, or internal policy requirements.
– Security Monitoring: Track failed login attempts, suspicious role changes, or admin access.
– Content Management: See when posts, pages, or products were updated, and by which user.
– Performance Tracking: Find which plugin or theme changes may have slowed down your site.

Translations

Does Logify speak your language? If not, translate “Logify” into your language.

DO YOU HAVE ANY QUESTIONS/ FEEDBACK/ FEATURE REQUEST/ BUG REPORT?

Feel free to create a ticket here. We love to communicate with you and reply to all your queries.

Spread The Word ❤️

If you like Logify, please leave us a ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ review and also spread the word about it via Facebook and Twitter. That helps fellow website owners assess Social Linkz easily and benefit from it!

URL Shortify helps you beautify, manage, and share any URL on or off of your WordPress website. Create links that look how you want using your domain name! It’s a Simple, Easy & Elegant self hosted alternative to Bitly, TinyURL, Cuttly, Pretty Links, URL Shortener By My Theme Shop, Rebrandly, BL.Link, Short.io, and many other SaaS URL Shortener services.

Update URLs

Quick and Easy way to search old links and replace them with new links in WordPress.

If you move your WordPress website to a new domain name, you will find that internal links to pages and references to images are not updated. Instead, these links and references will point to your old domain name. Update URLs fixes that problem by helping you change old urls and links in your website.

With Magic Link, users simply enter their email address, receive a unique login link, and gain instant access to their accounts. This plugin is perfect for improving user experience while maintaining strong security standards.

sections.installation:
The easy way..

  1. Go to WordPress Dashboard. Locate Plugins -> Add New
  2. Search Logify plugin using the search option
  3. Find the plugin and click Install Now button
  4. After installation, click on Activate Plugin link to activate the plugin.

The hard way..

  1. Download the plugin logify.zip
  2. Go to WordPress Dashboard. Locate Plugins -> Add New
  3. Click on the Upload Plugin link from the top
  4. Upload the downloaded logify.zip file and click on Install Now
  5. After installation, click on Activate Plugin link to activate the plugin.
sections.faq:
Does Logify work with Multisite?

Yes, Logify is fully compatible with WordPress Multisite. You can activate it on the main site or individual subsites to track user activities across your network.

Is Logify GDPR compliant?

Yes, Logify is designed with GDPR compliance in mind. It includes features like IP anonymization and data retention settings to help you manage user data responsibly.

Can I filter logs by user or event type?

Yes, Logify provides advanced filtering options that allow you to search logs by specific users, event types, or date ranges for easier monitoring.

How long are logs stored?

By default, logs are stored indefinitely. However, you can configure custom retention settings in the plugin settings to automatically delete logs after a specified period.

Can I export the activity logs?

Yes, Logify allows you to export activity logs in CSV or JSON format for reporting or auditing purposes.

Who can access the activity logs?

By default, only administrators have access to view the activity logs. This ensures that sensitive information is protected.

Does Logify track WooCommerce activities?

Yes, Logify PRO includes built-in integrations to track WooCommerce activities such as order changes, product updates, and customer details.

Is there a way to clear all logs at once?

Yes, Logify provides an option to clear all logs from the plugin settings. Additionally, you can use WP CLI commands to manage logs from the command line.

How do I uninstall Logify completely?

To completely uninstall Logify and remove all plugin data, simply deactivate and delete the plugin from your WordPress dashboard. The uninstall process will automatically clean up all related data from your database.

Where can I get support?

You can get support by creating a ticket on the WordPress.org support forum or by visiting our support page.
